title: Component-normalized tensor-Hom equivalence on homotopy classes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $P,L,I$ arbitrary integer-indexed complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Write $q$ for the homotopy-category quotient and $T=\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes L)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There is an equivalence $e:\operatorname{Hom}(qP,q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(qT,qI)$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. For every chain map $\varphi:P\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I)$ there exists a chain map $\psi:T\to I$ with $e(q\varphi)=q\psi$ and, for every $p+r=n$, the restriction of $\psi^n$ to $P^p\otimes L^r$ is the symmetry $P^p\otimes L^r\to L^r\otimes P^p$ followed by the inverse sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction applied to $\varphi^p$ followed by the Hom product projection $\mathcal Hom^p(L,I)\to\mathcal Hom(L^r,I^{r+p})$ [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. No flatness or injectivity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A90, Lemma 21.34.1; passage to homotopy classes using Tag 0A8Z

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed additive equivalences on ordinary cochains and their differential compatibility. Restrict to degree-zero cocycles using Cocycle.equivHom. Cochain.equivHomotopy identifies a homotopy with a degree-minus-one cochain whose differential is the difference of the representatives. The equivalence and its inverse therefore preserve homotopy. Map each homotopy class using its representative out, and prove representative independence with homotopyOfEq and eq_of_homotopy. Use the inverse chain-map equivalence to prove the two inverse laws. Finally apply the degree-zero component calculation to Cochain.ofHom of each representative to get the required normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalizedHomotopyTensorHom (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory X.sheaf
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)
    ∃ e : (q.obj P ⟶ q.obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L I)) ≃
        (q.obj (pullbackTensorTotal X P L) ⟶ q.obj I),
      ∀ φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L I,
        ∃ ψ : pullbackTensorTotal X P L ⟶ I,
          (∀ (p r n : ℤ) (h : p + r = n) (h' : r + p = n),
            HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P L (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p r n h ≫
              ψ.f n =
              (β_ (P.X p) (L.X r)).hom ≫
                (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (L.X r) (P.X p) (I.X n)).symm
                  (φ.f p ≫ homTensorProjection X.sheaf L I p r n h')) ∧
          e (q.map φ) = q.map ψ
